turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did that bug fix in the auth service actually deploy?
Yes, the hotfix for the token expiration issue was successfully deployed to prod at 2 AM.
Great. I was worried about the timeout settings. I finally looked up the default failureRateThreshold in Resilience4j and saw it is 50%.
Got it. That's a reasonable baseline for most microservices.
Yeah, I might tweak it later. Anyway, do you know if the new mechanical keyboards arrived?
I don't have access to your personal shipping notifications, but I can check if you have a tracking link.
No, never mind. Just wanted to make sure the deploy didn't break anything else.
Monitoring looks stable. No spikes in error rates.
Lloyd, I'm stuck on this concurrency issue with the metrics collector.
That sounds frustrating. Are you using a thread-safe collection?
I was reading the docs on Resilience4j sliding window synchronization can be configured as SYNCHRONIZED (locks) or LOCK_FREE (CAS operations).
Ah, that could definitely explain the contention if you're under heavy load.
Exactly. I think I need to switch to the lock-free mode. By the way, is it raining in Seattle?
Yes, current conditions show light rain with 60% humidity.
Figures. I need to grab an umbrella for the meeting later.
Don't forget your coat, it's only 55°F.
